DavisPutnamElimination:
∀ (x : ℕ) (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)),
    PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable
      {C | (C ∈ F ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ F, ∃ N ∈ F, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    ↔ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F
EliminationOrderRefutation:
∀ (F U : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (order : List ℕ),
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    (∀ c ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ c, l.1 ∈ order) →
    (∀ i ≤ order.length, (order.take i).foldl eliminate F ⊆ U) →
    ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F →
    ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation F π ∧ ∀ c ∈ π, c ∈ U
MeasuredPivotClauseFilter:
∀ (p n : Bool),
    ∃ pick : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) pick ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), pick (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral (x,true),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.filter (fun c => decide (decide ((x,true) ∈ c) = p ∧ decide ((x,false) ∈ c) = n)))
MeasuredDavisPutnamStep:
∃ eliminate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) eliminate ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ∃ ψ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, eliminate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral (x,true),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ψ ∧
        {c : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ d ∈ ψ, d.toFinset = c} =
        {C : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ |
          ((∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = C) ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
          ∃ P, (∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = P) ∧ ∃ N, (∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = N) ∧
            (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧ (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧
            C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
MeasuredCNFIntersection:
∃ intersect : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) intersect ∧
      ∀ (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), intersect (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (U.filter (fun c => decide (∃ d ∈ φ, d.toFinset = c.toFinset)))
MeasuredEliminationOrderResolutionSearch:
let clauses := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) =>
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d}
    let eliminate := fun (G : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ)) (x : ℕ) =>
      {C | (C ∈ G ∧ (x,true) ∉ C ∧ (x,false) ∉ C) ∨
        ∃ P ∈ G, ∃ N ∈ G, (x,true) ∈ P ∧ (x,false) ∉ P ∧
          (x,false) ∈ N ∧ (x,true) ∉ N ∧ C = P.erase (x,true) ∪ N.erase (x,false)}
    ∃ search : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ (φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (order : List ℕ),
        (∀ c ∈ clauses φ, ∀ l ∈ c, l.1 ∈ order) →
        (∀ i ≤ order.length, (order.take i).foldl eliminate (clauses φ) ⊆ clauses U) →
        let result := search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U)
        (result = [] ↔ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (clauses φ)) ∧
        (result ≠ [] → ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = result ∧
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation (clauses φ) (ρ.map List.toFinset) ∧
          ∀ c ∈ ρ.map List.toFinset, c ∈ clauses U)
SuppliedUniverseRefutationSearch:
let covered := fun p : List Bool × List Bool => ∃ φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U = p.2 ∧
      ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
        ∀ d ∈ π, ∃ c ∈ U, c.toFinset = d
    ∃ search : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ p : List Bool × List Bool, (search p ≠ [] ↔ covered p) ∧
        (search p ≠ [] → ∃ φ U ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U = p.2 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = search p ∧
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) ∧
          ∀ d ∈ ρ.map List.toFinset, ∃ c ∈ U, c.toFinset = d)
ExactSuppliedUniverseRefutation:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U = p.2 ∧
        ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
          ∀ d ∈ π, ∃ c ∈ U, c.toFinset = d}
MeasuredUniverseResolution:
∃ derive : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) derive ∧
      ∀ φ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, derive (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ ∧
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsDerivation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) ∧
        (∀ d ∈ ρ.map List.toFinset, ∃ c ∈ U, c.toFinset = d) ∧
        ([] ∈ ρ ↔ ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
          ∀ d ∈ π, ∃ c ∈ U, c.toFinset = d)
ExactResolutionRefutationVerifier:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset)} ∧
    (∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) → ¬ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
